description: This PHP source file defines the Language controller class within the Opencart admin module, managing language selection and saving functions for the admin panel.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing language selection and persistence in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of available admin panel languages and sets the active language, generating the view for language selection.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and saves the selected language, updating cookies and redirecting accordingly within the admin panel.
